name: Replication Data for: A fresh spin on an old classic: Multimodal mapping of neuronal diversity in the anteroventral cochlear nucleus
description: This repository contains three types of datasets that were used to characterise the anteroventral cochlear nucleus (AVCN) in Mongolian gerbil in the following article: "A fresh spin on an old classic: Multimodal mapping of neuronal diversity in the anteroventral cochlear nucleus" by Sabina Nowakowska, Jana Henseler, Elena Kleemann, Antoine Huet. Folder 'ephys' contains electrophysiological data - single unit recordings with sharp micropipettes performed in vivo under isoflurane anaesthesia. The dataset contains raw neuronal responses to pure tones at characteristic frequency (CF) and timestamps of detected spikes stored in .mat files. Statistics summarising those responses per unit are stored in .csv tables. Folder 'imaging' contains raw images of cochlear nucleus slices stained for MAP2, parvalbumin, calretinin, vGlut1 and DAPI obtained using spinning disc microscope. Dataset also contains trained models for cell detection using Cellpose framework (Stringer et al., 2021) and their predictions. Different cell properties quantified for cell detected with the model are summarised in .csv tables. Folder 'in_vitro_tracing' contains images of neurons filled with 1% Alexa Fluor hydrazide during in vitro patch clamp recordings from the cochlear nucleus and results of tracing dendrites with Simple Neurite Tracer. All parts contain 'src' folder with all the source code needed to reproduce the analysis presented in the publication from raw data to figures. Directory structure and further explanations of files are stored in the README files. See the related manuscript for the full description of methods and discussion of results.
